nodes.description: Contract owner address, set from msg.sender in constructor and used as privileged access gate.
Public mapping of token balances, mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom, _mints and batchSend.
Public nested mapping of allowances, decremented without SafeMath in transferFrom.
Whitelisted trade address, bypasses sale conditions in ensure().
Mapping of addresses allowed to sell, set in _mints.
Per-address sale counter incremented on each transferFrom.
Minimum sale amount, set by init().
Maximum sale amount, set by init().
Number of allowed sales per address, set by init().
Total token supply, set in constructor.
Token name set in constructor.
Token symbol set in constructor.
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
Internal whitelist/condition gate called by transferFrom; calls pairFor and condition.
Public payable transfer entry point mutating allowance, balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approval setting allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal sale gating function reading _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary address and calldata.
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and sets canSale[spender].
Owner-only initialization of sale limits _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batched balance transfer with unchecked multiplication/subtraction.
Owner-only setter for tradeAddress whitelist.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation used by ensure.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply, owner and initial allowances.
Caller-controlled address used for authorization and allowance checks.
Low-level delegatecall to an attacker-supplied address executing arbitrary code in contract context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value with no SafeMath (only a pre-check require).
balanceOf[_to] += _value with no overflow protection.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value performed without SafeMath.
_onSaleNum[_from]++ incremented with no overflow protection.
_mints sets balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) with unchecked scaling arithmetic.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length and subtracts without SafeMath.
batchSend adds _value to balanceOf[_to] per iteration without SafeMath.

Spender parameter of _mints.

token parameter of init used for _minSale.
maxToken parameter of init used for _maxSale.
Array of recipient addresses _tos of batchSend.

Loop index i in batchSend.

edges.reason: owner state variable is assigned directly from msg.sender in the constructor.
msg.sender is compared against _from to decide allowance consumption in transferFrom.
require(msg.sender == owner) gates the delegatecall in delegate.
_mints requires msg.sender to be owner or a hardcoded privileged address.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before moving balances.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
init requires msg.sender == owner to set sale limits.
transfer delegates all logic to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) as a validity gate.
ensure invokes condition(_from,_value) for whitelisted addresses.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
condition reads _saleNum to cap the number of allowed sales.
condition reads _minSale to enforce a minimum transfer amount.
condition reads _maxSale to enforce a maximum transfer amount.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
transferFrom mutates balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_from] -= _value with no overflow check.
transferFrom performs balanceOf[_to] += _value with no overflow check.
transferFrom performs allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value without SafeMath.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] without SafeMath.
delegate reaches an arbitrary-address delegatecall after the owner check.
_mints performs balanceOf[spender] = addedValue*(10**decimals) without SafeMath.
_mints sets canSale[spender] = true granting sale privileges.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length then subtracts it unchecked.
batchSend adds _value to each recipient balance without overflow protection.
init writes _minSale from the token parameter.
init writes _maxSale from the maxToken parameter.
init writes _saleNum from the saleNum parameter.
setTradeAddress writes the privileged tradeAddress state variable.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply = _supply*(10**decimals) with unchecked multiplication.
constructor seeds balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
constructor grants infinite allowance to the UNI router address.
constructor assigns the name string.
constructor assigns the symbol string.
the unchecked increment updates the _onSaleNum mapping entry.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender] with the scaled addedValue.
unchecked subtraction writes the balanceOf[_from] storage slot.
unchecked addition writes the balanceOf[_to] storage slot.
unchecked subtraction writes the allowance storage slot.
batchSend total subtraction writes balanceOf[msg.sender].
batchSend loop addition writes balanceOf[_to] for each recipient.
delegatecall executes external attacker code inside the contract context, enabling reentrant state manipulation.
recipient parameter _to flows into transferFrom.
sender parameter _from flows into transferFrom.
amount parameter _value flows into unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
spender parameter determines which balance _mints overwrites.
addedValue parameter feeds the unchecked balance scaling in _mints.
addedValue is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow protection.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum by init.
token parameter is scaled by 10**decimals for _minSale.
maxToken parameter is scaled by 10**decimals for _maxSale.
_tos array parameter drives the batchSend loop.
_value parameter feeds the unchecked total computation.
_value multiplies _tos.length in the unchecked batchSend total.
local _UNI is computed inside and consumed by ensure.
local total is computed and checked inside batchSend.
loop-local _to is used as the transfer recipient in batchSend.
loop index i controls iteration in batchSend.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter belongs to the transferFrom function scope and should be folded into it.
Sender parameter belongs to the transferFrom function scope and should be folded into it.
Amount parameter belongs to transferFrom and drives its unchecked balance/allowance arithmetic.
Spender parameter defines the balance target in _mints and should be folded into that function.
addedValue parameter is the arithmetic input of _mints and merges into that function.
saleNum parameter is written into _saleNum by init.
token parameter is scaled and stored as _minSale by init.
maxToken parameter is scaled and stored as _maxSale by init.
_tos array parameter is the iteration source of the batchSend loop.
_value parameter drives the unchecked arithmetic in batchSend.
Local _UNI exists only inside ensure and should merge into that function.
Local total is computed inside batchSend and merges into it.
Loop-local _to lives inside batchSend and merges into it.
Loop index i is local to batchSend and merges into it.
